faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Guest Faculty positions at Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam UIT Jhabua is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Guest Faculty position is up to ₹30,000/- per month. This is a consolidated monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam University Institute of Technology Jhabua. Specific details regarding the venue will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications required for the Guest Faculty positions are as per AICTE/UGC qualifications. This typically includes a relevant Master's degree.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty positions is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the Google form link provided in the Important Links section. Ensure all details are filled correctly before submission.

faq.question: Q9. Which departments are recruiting Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Guest Faculty positions in Computer Science Engineering (CSE), Mathematics, Physics, and Electrical & Electronics departments.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions are temporary in nature. This is a contractual role offered by the institute.
